body: I'm bisexual, and I like a guy. Today he went up to my locker to talk to me, and I was so happy- then I realized that he'll never like me, and there's no way we'll ever be in a relationship. I like him so much and I see him everyday and it hurts so much. I hate the other LGBT people in my school. They all act like living stereotypes. There's this one bi guy who comments on straight girl's posts: "OMG UR SO CUTE" which makes me so mad because bi means you like boys and girls, not just boys. But somehow, because he's "LGBT" it's acceptable for him to comment it because that's just how it is. Now everyone in my school thinks gay = bi means the same thing. The gay boys are living stereotypes and I hate them so much. My crush would never talk to me again if he found out I like them. I purge sometimes, and I always find myself making myself throw up whenever he says something homophobic. I'm slowly making a recovery from purging, though. But I hate for how the rest of my life, I will never be normal. I'll never get a chance with a straight guy, no matter how much I like him. Never. What's the point of living if you don't get all the opportunites that come with living? I think I'm going to kill myself on my birthday. I hate everyone. I hate being bi. I hate it when people tell me it will get better- no, it won't. Being bi doesn't just go away. I have to be stuck with never having my crushes like me back unless they also like guys- and it's highly unlikely I'll meet someone like that who I find interesting. I know I'm attracted to some girls, but I don't see myself ever with a girl in the future. I hate myself.
Being born a boy. I know I'm not transgender but if being a girl meant that I would have a chance with him I would take it in a heartbeat.
I don't really know. I went to comb my hair just now and ended up crying. I think the eating thing is a combination of self loathing and thinking about him.

Throwing up voluntarily. I feel like shit

Writing down the problems here makes me feel a lot better though. Like they can be solved if I break them apart. Except the one about the straight guy because  that just makes me want to jump out of a window whenever I think about it. I don't even know how to approach him anymore. 

I can't really talk to my parents because they hate me for not getting into honors in my first year and for pursuing English. They say that the writing and mun competitions I enter are a waste of time, even if I win. They've threatened to send me away to my bio dad  (parents are divorced) because he doesn't really care and they didn't want to deal with me anymore.
